verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed law firm that sells attorney-delivered legal services. A firm of this kind could plausibly offer a client-facing tool with an AI assistant, so the question applies. Nothing in the evidence describes any built-in AI assistant that clients can delegate tasks to: the docs stress work done by senior attorneys, and the probes found no llms.txt or API surface. Its AI-related content is about advising clients on AI products, which is a different matter.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
